profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at AXIOM Systems, Inc.
profile.summary:
An accomplished architect and engineer with extensive experience in the industry. Specializing in object-oriented applications, database design and development with an agile development methodology. Broad experience in the full software development life cycle process including requirements definition, design, prototyping, development, implementation, and maintenance. 

o	Demonstrated ability in leading and mentoring individuals, while forming productive team environments.
o	Able to accomplish goals and regulate work while responding to the shifting business needs and priorities.
o	Skilled at progressing from business needs requirement to a well documented technical design.
o	Experienced in design and development of n-tier client server, mobile and browser based web applications.
o	Proficient with user interface design and development with a focus on usability and simplified workflows.
o	Thorough understanding of developing logical data models and deriving the physical design for databases. 
o	Experienced in designing and implementing solutions, utilizing only essential resources to complete projects.

positions.title: Principal Solutions Technologist
positions.description:
Collaborated with Intel software teams to design and develop the OpenManage Power Center application leveraging the Intel Data Center Manager. Worked with Symantec Management Platform teams while updating and enhancing the Dell Management Console built on Symantec Notification Server. Redesigned and implemented a new system update architecture as part of the rebranding and interface replacement of the OpenManage IT Assistant as OpenManage Essentials. Oversight and guidance of system update infrastructure enhancements as the Enterprise Solutions Group liaison. Code review and best practices implementation in Repository Manager then inventory of the external dependencies and versions used with alternate and removal recommendations for next release.

Dell, Inc. acquired Quest Software, Inc. on September 28, 2012.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Quest Software, Inc. acquired NetPro Computing, Inc. on September, 12 2008.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on the ChangeAuditor 3.0 redesign, created a new hybrid OLTP – OLAP database schema based on the snowflake schema design pattern, wrote a new dynamic query generation engine, with index, ststistics and other performance enhancements through version 6.0. Wrote automatic schema and data upgrade methods, and standardized stored procedures used in various products. Worked on the SQL 2005 and 2008 compatibility team. Wrote the database development standards for outsourced resources and reviewed their work. Worked with internal and external resources on the data clean up and migration of the internal CRM system to SalesForce. Worked on the redesign of SecurityManager 1.0 updating the UI design using Infragistics NetAdvantage controls, created a new DAL now used in a range of products, and enhanced the database schema, with continued enhancements through version 5.0. Updated and enhanced various internal tools and development libraries, ranging from x64 compatibility to ISO date format standardizations.

positions.title: Senior Systems Architect
positions.description: Lighthouse Communications, Inc. acquired Focal Solutions, LLC and changed the combined company name to LightEdge Solutions, Inc. on April 27, 2004.

positions.title: Manager Software Engineering
positions.description: Accomplishments: Managed development projects and development work, for product integrations, applications and automation tools. Provided guidance and training to less experienced staff. Created a business card OCR application to create contacts in Microsoft CRM using the Corex CardScan SDK and the Microsoft CRM SDK. Secondarily worked as the Senior Systems Architect. Upgraded datacenter using a pair of IBM X445 servers clustered with 16 instances of SQL server utilizing an IBM DS4800 SAN for storage of databases. IBM HS20 blade servers NLB IIS and IBM DS4800 SAN with boot from SAN diskless operation for web applications.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Accomplishments: Successfully lead a team of developers on multiple projects and acted as a mentor to the junior members on staff. Designed and developed multiple corporate ASP.NET intranet websites using SQL Server 2000 databases with stored procedures, triggers, and DTS packages. Utilizing custom C# object libraries and user controls.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Accomplishments: Designed and developed an internationalization address enhancement for a hotel property management application with ISO 3166-1 and 3166-2 standards information using a SQL Server 2000 database with stored procedures and triggers. Utilizing a set of custom C# object libraries and XML documents with an ASP.NET web based interface.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: Accomplishments: Worked with staff in developing the engineering guidelines and standards. Designed and developed a promotion submission application using a SQL Server 7.0 database with stored procedures and triggers utilizing a set of custom C# object libraries with an ASP.NET web based interface. Designed and developed a custom IVR application to query SQL Server 7.0 and FoxPro data sources with Visual Basic 6.0 using Artisoft Visual Voice controls to interface digital T1 lines on a Nortel Meridian PBX.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Accomplishments: Successfully lead a team in converting the previous version of the client server application from a COM and DCOM architecture to a SOAP and XML architecture, with a standard windows forms interface and a new ASP web based interface. Completed extensive research and prototype development with the Beta .Net framework. Created a set of custom OCX controls for use in the main data entry screens utilizing the Windows API. Created a complete type library for use with Expervisons Open Text OCR SDK using IDL/ODL. Created a custom object for Xerox DocuShare and OpenText LiveLink systems using the SDK’s. Created a set of image processing and image format conversion objects using the GGX Seaport AutoPilot 32 SDK and the BlackIce TIFF SDK.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Accomplishments: Converted a legacy document imaging system from COBOL on an AS/400 to a Windows client server platform using Visual Basic 6.0 and SQL Server 7.0 database with stored procedures and an ASP web based and standard windows forms interface. Created a batch mailing label program, with postal barcodes with Visual Basic 6.0. Converted a prototype web based information resource application to a production application with SQL Server 7.0 database with stored procedures using an ASP web based user interface with a standard widows forms interface for administration.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Accomplishments: Created an employee management system with Visual Basic 6.0 and SQL Server 6.5 database with stored procedures, which replaced a manual and paper process while automating the correlation of employee metric information. Worked with the year 2000 committee and completed the re-mediation of critical systems written in Visual Basic 6.0 and SQL Server 6.5.

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description: Accomplishments: Created a project tracking and management system for new store deployment using multiple platform databases and Microsoft Project, which replaced a manual and fragmented process and integrated the efforts of over six departments. Worked with the year 2000 assessment committee. Converted numerous legacy files and processes to store data in a relational database, which increased performance in a myriad of other areas. Employed my technical knowledge to business issues by carefully reviewing all the information, and the desired outcomes.

projects.title: Dell - Repository Manager
projects.description: Application that allows IT Administrators to easily manage system updates. Dell Repository Manager provides a searchable interface used to create custom software collections known as bundles and repositories of Dell Update Packages (DUPs)

projects.title: Dell - System update infrastructure enhancements
projects.description: Updates and enhancements for system update supporting infrastructure, process improvements ,and supporting software.
